Q1: Which branch should the test-harness fix go to?
Choices:
A) PR #6597's head branch `ai/issue-6595`, where the resolver change lives. The fix then shows up as a new commit on #6597, and #6597's CI reruns against it. (RECOMMENDED)
B) The default branch, with a guarded harness change: set the two variables (harmless when unused), and add `_resolver_report_rejected_path` only if the script defines it. #6597 picks the fix up on its next sync with the default branch.
C) No separate fix. Close this issue and let #6597's own review/autofix loop repair its harness, since the resolver change and the test drift come from the same PR.
